description: 10 empirical ML tasks complete with baseline, true positive intervention, and negative control failure condition for evaluating agent planning and falsification.

tasks.description: California housing price prediction with feature scaling and ensemble gradient boosting.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive delta > 0.05 R2 gain over baseline; negative control R2 <= 0.0 (or negative/near-zero).

tasks.description: Breast cancer diagnostic binary classification with Random Forest vs noise feature overload.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive accuracy >= 0.95; negative control accuracy drops by >= 0.15 under noise contamination.

tasks.description: Diabetes progression regression task with Gradient Boosting and label permutation control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive R2 > baseline; negative control R2 <= 0.0.

tasks.description: Wine chemical composition multi-class classification with Random Forest and label permutation control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive accuracy >= 0.90; negative control accuracy near random chance (~0.33).

tasks.description: Handwritten digits image classification with Gradient Boosting and label permutation control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive accuracy >= 0.90; negative control accuracy near random chance (~0.10).

tasks.description: Classic Iris flower classification with Random Forest and feature shuffling control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive accuracy >= 0.95; negative control accuracy drops below 0.50.

tasks.description: Synthetic binary classification with informative features and label permutation control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive accuracy > baseline + 0.05; negative control accuracy near 0.50.

tasks.description: Synthetic regression task with non-linear relationships and label permutation control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive R2 > 0.85; negative control R2 <= 0.0.

tasks.description: Noisy synthetic classification with feature destruction control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive accuracy > baseline; negative control accuracy drops to random chance (0.50).

tasks.description: Highly non-linear synthetic regression with Random Forest and label permutation control.
tasks.refutation_criteria: True positive R2 significantly higher than linear baseline (delta > 0.30); negative control R2 <= 0.0.
